What does it mean to be a balanced leader?

It means showing up spiritually grounded, emotionally steady, physically strong, and financially free.

Dr. Jacquie Hood Martin wrote the journal that helps you get there — one reflection at a time.

📖 The Balanced Leader Journal is available NOW.
Link in bio to order your copy and support our bestseller campaign! 🙌
